title: calophaca soongorica var. tianschanica
intro: Calophaca soongorica var. tianschanica, commonly known as Tianschan Calophaca, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, native to the Tianshan Mountains in China. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Tianshan Calophaca include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects, making it potentially useful in treating various conditions such as liver disease and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
